videos.title: vtiger CRM  Installation // Open Source Introduction, Installation and Configuration
videos.description:
In this video you will learn to install vtiger CRM , an open-source community edition which can be downloaded from Sourceforge. 

Vtiger CRM is better than odoo CRM. The community edition of vTiger is for Free. Hosted vtiger comes with subscription charges but if you can host by yourself you don't need to pay anything. 

I have installed on on Oracle Free VM  https://youtu.be/U3bzHgjRJAQ
I have also installed aaPanel https://youtu.be/yKR4ZcrKzUQ

Then I created the CRM.

I have been using Sugur CRM as open source and Zoho as commercial , but vtiger is best open source so far.

When it comes to integration you can use vtiger API to connect to external applications.

vtiger CRM is  mobile friendly web application as it is responsive design.
